name: Admiration
overview: Scripture reveals that true admiration is directed toward God the Father and is expressed through worship in spirit and truth, as He seeks genuine worshippers (John 4:23). Jesus exemplifies this admiration by perfectly reflecting the Father's actions, demonstrating complete submission and unity with Him (John 5:19). Believers are called to honor God above all, obeying Him rather than men, recognizing Him as both Father and God (John 20:17; Acts 5:29). This admiration is not mere sentiment but a commitment to follow and obey God faithfully.
